title: MAGA Faction Ousts Kevin McCarthy as House Speaker
description_short: MAGA Faction Ousts Kevin McCarthy as House Speaker
description_medium: On October 3, 2023, Kevin McCarthy became the first Speaker in U.S. history to be removed by a motion to vacate, losing 216-210. The ouster was led by Rep. Matt Gaetz and aligned with Trump MAGA hardliners who believed McCarthy had made too many compromises. The vote threw the House into weeks of chaos as Republicans struggled to find a replacement. The dysfunction demonstrated that Trump MAGA faction could paralyze the Republican legislative agenda in pursuit of ideological purity.
description_long: The House removed Speaker Kevin McCarthy on October 3, 2023 by a 216–210 vote on a motion to vacate. The supplied account identifies Representative Matt Gaetz as the leader of the effort and associates it with MAGA hardliners who considered McCarthy too willing to compromise. McCarthy was the first House speaker removed through that mechanism. The vote created an immediate leadership vacancy and left Republicans struggling for weeks to select a replacement. These are concrete institutional consequences of the ouster, distinct from broader arguments about the motives of every member who voted for it. The connection to Trump's faction rests on the alignment described in the supplied material, not on evidence that Trump personally cast votes or issued every instruction. The supported event records the historic removal, the vote total and the resulting succession dispute. It does not establish that each participant shared an identical rationale or that the House remained permanently unable to act.
